Allegany College of Maryland is a high quality, low cost educational community college with its main campus set in the mountains of Maryland's Allegany County and branch locations in Pennsylvania's Bedford and Somerset Counties. We are a college that cares about our students and the communities we serve. ACM is open to all students who can benefit from collegiate instruction. Admission or readmission to certain programs is selective; but for the most part, Allegany College of Maryland maintains an open door admissions policy.

We take pride in our outstanding students and graduates and in their accomplishments and career success. The fact that 100% of employers were found to be "likely" or "very likely" to hire additional program graduates from our college is a point of pride for us. 

For general information on Allegany College of Maryland, please call us at 301-784-5000 or email infocenter@alleg
